summary: Core facts about the awards, winners and Aaydan are confirmed, but the passage wrongly calls Maya Pandit pro-vice chancellor of EFLU, says 'debut fiction' (debut winners include nonfiction), and includes an unverifiable 'biggest names' claim. Q2-Q5 are OK; Q1 and Q6 have correct keys but cross-question answer leakage (Q6 statements repeat Q1/Q2 facts).
